entities.summary: Araxá is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. It is located approximately 370 kilometers northwest of the state capital Belo Horizonte, with an area of 1,283 square kilometres (495 sq mi), and 3.45 square kilometres (1.33 sq mi) designated as the urban perimeter. As of 2022, the population is 111,691.
